name: context-economy
description: Session cost, context hygiene and compaction safety for any session: measure what a session costs, guard large inputs and reads, prompt for a subagent model rung, and keep the auto-compact window clear of the session's floor.

hooks.command: PY="${SPEND_PYTHON:-}"; [ -x "$PY" ] || PY=/usr/bin/python3; [ -x "$PY" ] || PY=python3; for d in "$SPEND_SKILL_DIR" "$CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT" "$HOME/.claude/skills/delegating-economically/../.." "$HOME/.agents/skills/delegating-economically/../.." ; do [ -f "$d/scripts/spend.py" ] || continue; exec "$PY" "$d/scripts/spend.py" cost --format hook; done; exit 0

[ -t 0 ] && exit 0; p=$(cat); f=${SPEND_GUARD_HEREDOC_BYTES:-${ORCH_GUARD_HEREDOC_BYTES:-1200}}; b=${SPEND_GUARD_BYTES:-${ORCH_GUARD_BYTES:-6000}}; { [ "$b" -lt "$f" ] && f=$b; } 2>/dev/null; case "$p" in *Read*) ;; *) { [ ${#p} -lt "$f" ] && exit 0; } 2>/dev/null ;; esac; PY="${SPEND_PYTHON:-}"; [ -x "$PY" ] || PY=/usr/bin/python3; [ -x "$PY" ] || PY=python3; for d in "$SPEND_SKILL_DIR" "$CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT" "$HOME/.claude/skills/delegating-economically/../.." "$HOME/.agents/skills/delegating-economically/../.." ; do [ -f "$d/scripts/spend.py" ] || continue; printf %s "$p" | "$PY" "$d/scripts/spend.py" guard; exit $?; done; exit 0

PY="${SPEND_PYTHON:-}"; [ -x "$PY" ] || PY=/usr/bin/python3; [ -x "$PY" ] || PY=python3; for d in "$SPEND_SKILL_DIR" "$CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT" "$HOME/.claude/skills/delegating-economically/../.." "$HOME/.agents/skills/delegating-economically/../.." ; do [ -f "$d/scripts/spend.py" ] || continue; exec "$PY" "$d/scripts/spend.py" rung; done; exit 0

PY="${SPEND_PYTHON:-}"; [ -x "$PY" ] || PY=/usr/bin/python3; [ -x "$PY" ] || PY=python3; for d in "$SPEND_SKILL_DIR" "$CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT" "$HOME/.claude/skills/delegating-economically/../.." "$HOME/.agents/skills/delegating-economically/../.." ; do [ -f "$d/scripts/spend.py" ] || continue; exec "$PY" "$d/scripts/spend.py" compaction check --format hook; done; exit 0
